title: Excellent guide. Very nice tour.
text: My wife and I enjoyed our trip with Bea. She actually lives in Triana, loves it here, and was very enthusiastic about it. It was a very good tour. Bea knew her history and conveyed it to us in a very relaxing, knowledgeable way. This tour was a nice contrast to the massive crowds in the Cathedral and Real Alcazar tours we also took.
author: 493thomasc

title: Fantastic guide
text: Our guide was extremely knowledgable. She spent plenty of time answering question and helped us find local dining spot that were off the beaten track!
author: Guide8954

title: A great tour
text: Beatriz is very knowledgeable about history and her city and is excited to share it with visitors. We learned a lot and  really enjoyed seeing the Triana neighborhood.
